seasonalityNotes: October to December brings dry, cool air and the clearest skies of the northern year; June to August is hot and humid with heavy afternoon rain.
gettingAround: Noi Bai (HAN) sits about 27 km north of the centre; the airport bus, taxis and Grab typically reach the Old Quarter in 40–60 minutes.

promotion.title: LotuStudents — up to 10% off connecting itineraries
promotion.summary: Verified students aged 15–31 can receive up to 10% off Premium Economy Classic, Economy Classic and Economy Lite fares on international itineraries connecting in Vietnam. Registration, document verification and peak-period exclusions apply.

lotusmilesIndicative.note: Veya indicative distance proxy: ~3,739 miles (PER–SGN 3,018 + SGN–HAN 721). Actual Lotusmiles accrual depends on eligible booking class and qualifying segments. low/mid/high is a Veya internal signal, not a Lotusmiles tier.
